stratagem.name: ANNIHILATING FORCE
stratagem.lore: Knowing well their duty to shatter the foe’s lines, these warriors strike with devastating strength.
stratagem.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit is selected to attack.

stratagem.name: PURGATION PUSH
stratagem.lore: Gravis assault tactics stipulate a relentless advance coupled with unfaltering firepower.
stratagem.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit has shot.
stratagem.effect: ▪ If your unit is unengaged, your unit can make a normal move of up to 5", and must end that move within range of an objective. ▪ Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge or embark within a TRANSPORT until the end of the turn.

stratagem.name: ARMOURED IMPACT
stratagem.lore: Throwing their armoured mass into an assault, a Space Marine in Gravis armour can crush and trample their foe.
stratagem.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly GRAVIS unit ends a charge move.
stratagem.effect: When your unit ends a charge move, you can select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. If you do, roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit: ▪ For each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
